$comment: CP-R2 datacenter/VPN heuristic for borrow flows (StaticRangeReputation). IPv4 CIDRs of hosting providers and commercial VPN exits. This static list is a starting point: refresh it from the providers' published ranges (e.g. ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json, gstatic.com/ipranges/cloud.json, Azure service tags) or swap the IpReputation implementation for a commercial feed. Override with DATACENTER_RANGES (comma-separated CIDRs).
